candidate.definition_en: To speak very softly using one's breath without one's vocal cords.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تتكلم بصوت واطي جداً 'تهس' عشان محدش يسمعك.

senses.definition_en: To speak very softly using one's breath without one's vocal cords.
senses.definition_ar: أن يتكلم بصوت خافت جداً بحيث لا يكاد يُسمع.
examples: You can whisper your secret to me.
They had to whisper so no one would overhear them.
You can whisper your secret to me.
They had to whisper so no one would overhear them.
candidate.mnemonic: زي ما بنقول بالمصري 'وسوسة'.. 'Whisper' قريبة في النطق والمعنى 'كلام واطي'.
